title: Side Hustle Money: The One Rule That Saves You
hook_text: YOUR FIRST DOLLAR IS A RED FLAG

beats.say: The first dollar your side hustle earns should not touch your checking account.
beats.visual: extreme close-up of a crisp $1 bill on a wet asphalt road, sodium vapor light casting long shadows, rain droplets magnified

beats.say: Mix it in and you lose the trail. Come tax time, you’re guessing.
beats.visual: high angle of a scattered pile of receipts and a phone with a cracked screen, dim fluorescent light from above

beats.say: Where does that money go? How much did you really make?
beats.visual: silhouette of a person holding a laptop against a stormy skyline, backlit by distant city lights

beats.say: Most people dump it all in one account. It’s simpler, right?
beats.visual: low angle of a single debit card propped against a concrete wall, cold blue hour lighting

beats.say: But the IRS doesn’t care about simple. They care about the paper.
beats.visual: towering stack of manila folders with a single red flag pinned to the top, shot from ground level

beats.say: Step one. Open a separate high-yield account today. Takes 5 minutes.
beats.visual: hands typing on a phone, glowing screen the only light source, deep shadows around

beats.say: Name it something obvious: ‘Freelance’ or ‘Etsy.’ No creative fluff.
beats.visual: extreme close-up of a phone screen showing an account named ‘SIDE HUSTLE,’ blurred for anonymity, shallow depth of field

beats.say: Step two. Move that first dollar into it. Then every dollar after.
beats.visual: a dollar bill sliding into a slot on a minimalist wooden desk, single practical light from the left

beats.say: Now you see every cent. And so does your accountant.
beats.visual: a leather-bound ledger with a pen resting on it, shot from above with a single desk lamp casting a warm glow

beats.say: Step three. Track it in a spreadsheet. Date, amount, project. That’s it.
beats.visual: a laptop screen displaying a simple spreadsheet, shot from behind the screen so text is unreadable, dark room with one monitor glow

beats.say: An extra $1,000 a month invested at 8% for 10 years? That’s $182,946. Not bad for a side gig.
beats.visual: extreme wide shot of an empty highway at night, a single headlight in the distance, star-filled sky

beats.say: But here’s the kicker: without the trail, you might not even know it’s there.
beats.visual: a split frame: left side shows a clean, organized desk with a calculator; right side shows a cluttered desk with coffee stains and loose papers, both under cold fluorescent light

beats.say: Separate the money from day one. Then you’ll know. And you’ll grow.
beats.visual: a single $1 bill pinned to a corkboard with a red thumbtack, shot in close-up with a soft bokah background

beats.say: Follow for the money rules nobody taught you.
beats.visual: a dimly lit underpass with a faint glow at the end, silhouettes moving through it, cinematic grain

caption: The first dollar of your side hustle should NEVER hit your checking. Here’s how to fix it in 15 minutes. #SideHustle #MoneyRules #TaxTips
description: Side hustle money needs its own account from day one. Three steps to separate it, track it, and let it grow without the tax headache.
first_comment: What’s the first thing you’d do with your side hustle’s first $100?
